description: Crisis events. Each opts item is [player-facing label, effect object]. Numeric values are model deltas.

leadership_challenge.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Leadership Challenge!
leadership_challenge.humphrey: Chancellor, your backbenchers have decided the Prime Minister is a liability. You must intervene to save them, or wield the knife yourself.
opts: Bribe the rebels with uncosted pet projects
Unleash the whips to threaten and bully them
Publicly support the PM but plot in secret

tabloid_scandal.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Major Tabloid Scandal!
tabloid_scandal.humphrey: Fleet Street has dug up some rather unedifying photographs of a senior Cabinet Minister, Chancellor. The press demands blood.
opts: Force the Minister to resign immediately
Defend the Minister and attack the press
Distract them by leaking a popular new tax cut

gilt_revolt.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Severe Gilt Market Revolt! Foreign investors dump UK debt as yields surge past 5.5%.
gilt_revolt.humphrey: Chancellor, the bond markets have taken a sudden and profound dislike to us. If we do not intervene, we may find ourselves in the rather novel position of national bankruptcy.
opts: Deploy emergency Bank of England intervention
Refuse intervention and let bond vigilantes feast
Announce an emergency package of brutal spending cuts to restore confidence

nhs_walkout.title: 🚨 BREAKING: National Health Service Staff Walkout! Nurses and junior doctors launch coordinated strikes.
nhs_walkout.humphrey: The medical practitioners have opted for a spontaneous cessation of labour, Chancellor. We could pay them, but that would set a terrifying precedent.
opts: Meet pay demands in full to avoid collapse
Stand firm and invoke emergency service minimums
Offer a one-off non-consolidated bonus

energy_bankruptcy.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Major Energy Retailer Bankruptcy! State bailout required to keep lights on.
energy_bankruptcy.humphrey: An energy firm has carelessly misplaced its capital, Chancellor. We can bail them out, or we can let the free market freeze the electorate.
opts: Absorb company liabilities into public balance sheet
Let customers scatter to higher tariffs
Broker a rescue by a rival firm with temporary state loans

pension_hole.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Public Sector Pension Black Hole Discovered! OBR mandates immediate funding correction.
pension_hole.humphrey: It appears there is a slight discrepancy in the pension fund. A 'black hole', the tabloids call it.
opts: Inject emergency cash reserves to plug shortfall
Cut departmental budgets across the board
Increase employee contribution rates to share the pain

cyber_attack.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Major Cyber Attack! HMRC and NHS systems are knocked offline by a hostile state actor.
cyber_attack.humphrey: Our computer systems have been compromised, Chancellor. Apparently 'Password123' was not as robust as the IT department claimed.
opts: Fund an emergency national cyber-security overhaul
Restore systems quietly and hope it does not recur
Pay the ransom quietly through an untraceable proxy

floods.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Catastrophic Winter Floods! Thousands of homes and several northern towns are underwater.
floods.humphrey: It is raining, Chancellor. And unfortunately, the water has decided to gather in places where people live.
opts: Launch a national flood recovery and defence fund
Leave recovery to councils and insurers
Deploy the army for logistics but provide no new cash

bank_run.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Regional Bank Run! Depositors queue outside a mid-sized lender as confidence evaporates.
bank_run.humphrey: The public has decided to withdraw their money from the banks all at once.
opts: Guarantee all deposits to stop contagion
Let it fail under the resolution regime
Force a shotgun merger with a high street giant

steel_closure.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Last Blast Furnace to Close! Thousands of jobs are at risk in a former industrial heartland.
steel_closure.humphrey: Heavy industry is heavy, Chancellor. And expensive. Nationalising it would save jobs but ruin the balance sheet.
opts: Nationalise the plant to save the jobs
Let the market decide
Provide heavy subsidies to transition to green steel

prison_riot.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Massive Prison Riot! Overcrowding has sparked a violent uprising in a major high-security facility.
prison_riot.humphrey: The criminal classes are expressing their displeasure with the accommodation, Chancellor.
opts: Approve emergency capital for new private prison contracts
Release non-violent offenders early to ease pressure
Send in the military and suppress it without new funding

ai_job_crisis.title: 🚨 BREAKING: White-Collar AI Bloodbath! Major city firms announce 50,000 job cuts, replacing staff with AI.
ai_job_crisis.humphrey: The robots are taking over the City, Chancellor. It seems algorithms are far cheaper than accountants.
opts: Implement an emergency "Robot Tax" to fund retraining
Embrace the efficiency and let the market adjust naturally
Ban AI from public sector procurement to protect state jobs

grid_blackout.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Rolling Blackouts! The National Grid has failed to meet peak winter demand.
grid_blackout.humphrey: The lights have gone out, Chancellor. The public is sitting in the dark.
opts: Bribe industrial users to shut down factories temporarily
Fire up decommissioned coal plants at massive expense
Allow rolling domestic blackouts to continue

farming_collapse.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Agricultural Collapse! A horrible harvest and post-Brexit red tape threatens domestic food supplies.
farming_collapse.humphrey: The farmers are threatening to drive their tractors down Whitehall, Chancellor.
opts: Inject emergency subsidies directly to farming businesses
Drop all food import tariffs to secure cheap foreign produce
Do nothing and allow food prices to naturally spike

flash_crash.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Currency Flash Crash! A rogue algorithmic trade has sent Sterling plummeting 10% in minutes.
flash_crash.humphrey: The Pound has fallen off a cliff, Chancellor. Importers are panicking, exporters are rejoicing.
opts: Order the BoE to burn foreign reserves to prop up the Pound
Let the currency find its new natural floor
Suspend trading on the London Stock Exchange temporarily

border_surge.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Border Crisis! Record Channel crossings overwhelm processing and hotel capacity.
border_surge.humphrey: The Home Office has miscalculated again, Chancellor. We are out of hotel rooms.
opts: Fund rapid processing and new returns deals
Announce tougher deterrence with no extra funding
Requisition disused military bases for basic camps

student_loans.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Student Loan Black Hole! The OBR warns a third of loans will never be repaid.
student_loans.humphrey: It turns out that lending billions of pounds to teenagers studying Media Studies was not a sound financial investment.
opts: Write down loans and reform the system
Freeze the repayment threshold to claw money back
Convert the loans into a permanent graduate tax

water_collapse.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Water Giant on the Brink! A major water company warns it cannot service its debts.
water_collapse.humphrey: A privatised monopoly has managed to bankrupt itself while selling something that literally falls from the sky.
opts: Place it into special administration
Back a rescue funded by higher customer bills
Impose fines and strip assets from the parent company

winter_flu.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Winter Flu Surge! A&E wards overflow and ambulances queue outside hospitals.
winter_flu.humphrey: Winter has arrived, Chancellor. An entirely predictable annual event.
opts: Fund emergency winter capacity
Rely on existing winter plans
Cancel elective surgeries and bring in military medics

rating_warning.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Credit Rating Warning! A major agency puts the UK on negative watch over weak public finances.
rating_warning.humphrey: A group of young men in New York with spreadsheets have decided they do not like your economic strategy.
opts: Publish a credible debt-reduction plan
Dismiss the warning as politically motivated
Lobby the agency privately and promise future reforms

capital_flight.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your aggressive socialist policies have sparked a sudden flight of millionaires to Dublin and Frankfurt!
capital_flight.humphrey: Chancellor, your policies have been deemed 'courageous' by the international elite.
opts: Offer tax exemptions for multinational executives
Double down with emergency capital export controls
Launch a patriotic investment bond to retain domestic capital

utility_failure.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your recent deregulation has caused private water and energy providers to suffer major infrastructure leaks!
utility_failure.humphrey: It seems the 'invisible hand' of the market is currently covered in raw sewage, Chancellor.
opts: Bail out the private operators with state emergency grants
Threaten forcible public receivership
Impose severe regulatory fines and force executive resignations

service_collapse.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your deep departmental spending cuts have resulted in crumbling school roofs and prison overcrowding!
service_collapse.humphrey: Chancellor, I did warn that cutting the maintenance budgets to zero might have physical consequences. Ceilings are falling in.
opts: Issue emergency capital grants to patch facilities
Maintain strict budget caps and ride out the public backlash
Launch a public-private partnership rebuilding scheme

police_revolt.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your spending freeze has pushed officers to the brink, and the Police Federation is threatening action!
police_revolt.humphrey: The police are quite cross, Chancellor. It is generally considered poor form for a government to annoy the people holding the truncheons.
opts: Fund a police pay settlement
Hold the line
Bring in the army to cover essential duties

wage_spiral.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Giant public pay deals have de-anchored inflation expectations across the economy!
wage_spiral.humphrey: We gave them the money, they spent it, and now everything costs more. It is a terrifying concept called 'economics'.
opts: Back the Bank of England with a tight fiscal squeeze
Let it ride and hope it fades
Implement a temporary freeze on all prices and rents

welfare_rebellion.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your disability benefit cuts have sparked mass protests and a backbench revolt!
welfare_rebellion.humphrey: Taking money from the vulnerable was a bold move, Chancellor. Tragically, the public has noticed.
opts: Reverse the harshest cuts
Press ahead regardless
Tweak the criteria to exempt the most severe cases

council_bankrupt.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your council spending cuts have pushed a major city council to issue a Section 114 bankruptcy notice!
council_bankrupt.humphrey: A rather large local authority has officially run out of money, Chancellor. They are blaming central government cuts.
opts: Bail the council out with a rescue package
Let government commissioners impose cuts
Allow them to raise local council tax above the legal cap

rail_collapse.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: A private rail consortium has walked away, leaving services in chaos!
rail_collapse.humphrey: The private sector has discovered that running trains is terribly hard work, so they have handed the keys back.
opts: Take the lines back into public operation
Find another bidder with a subsidy
Run a skeleton service using emergency bus replacements

greenbelt_revolt.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Rural MPs and councils are rebelling against mass development on protected land!
greenbelt_revolt.humphrey: The shires are in revolt, Chancellor. The prospect of actual, physical houses being built near them has driven them to madness.
opts: Offer communities a share of the gains
Force the plans through
Rebrand them as "Eco-Towns" with strict green criteria

retaliation.title: 🔗 LINKED REACTION: Your protectionist tariffs have triggered counter-tariffs on British exports!
retaliation.humphrey: It appears our trading partners did not appreciate our tariffs, Chancellor. They have retaliated.
opts: Negotiate a rapid de-escalation deal
Escalate and defend domestic industry
File a lengthy WTO dispute and ride it out

school_crisis.title: 📒 BUDGET FALLOUT: Dozens of schools close after safety warnings as education funding runs dry!
school_crisis.humphrey: Chancellor, you slashed the education budget, and now the schools are structurally failing. I am shocked.
opts: Fund emergency rebuilding
Move pupils into temporary units
Force schools to adopt remote learning indefinitely

defence_scare.title: 📒 BUDGET FALLOUT: A leaked report reveals critical defence shortfalls as tensions rise abroad!
defence_scare.humphrey: Your defence cuts have been leaked to the press, Chancellor. Apparently we cannot afford bullets.
opts: Announce an emergency defence uplift
Deny the report and defer spending
Reallocate funds from international aid to cover the gap

corp_exodus.title: 📒 BUDGET FALLOUT: Firms announce plans to move their headquarters as high corporation tax bites!
corp_exodus.humphrey: The corporations are leaving, Chancellor. They have looked at your new tax rates and politely decided to incorporate in Ireland instead.
opts: Offer a targeted tax relief package
Hold firm on the tax rate
Threaten them with exclusion from all future government contracts

fuel_protest.title: 📒 BUDGET FALLOUT: Hauliers and farmers blockade refineries as the fuel duty rise bites!
fuel_protest.humphrey: The lorries have stopped, Chancellor. It turns out that a country runs on diesel and goodwill, and you have taxed both.
opts: Reverse the fuel duty rise at once
Hold firm and send in the police
Offer targeted relief for hauliers and rural drivers

brain_drain.title: 📒 BUDGET FALLOUT: Leading labs announce a move to America as research funding withers!
brain_drain.humphrey: The scientists are leaving, Chancellor. Apparently they prefer to be funded. We had assumed gratitude would suffice.
opts: Launch an emergency research retention fund
Let them go and rely on the market
Offer tax breaks for returning researchers
